opa-01-c1.quote: A basic result is that abstractly, Hilbert spaces of the same dimension are all of the same type
opa-01-c1.claim: Two Hilbert spaces of the same Hilbert dimension (cardinality of an orthonormal basis) are unitarily isomorphic.

opa-02-c3.quote: Originally and typically by default the GNS construction is considered for C*-algebras and C*-representations (Gelfand & Naimark 1943, Segal 1947, cf. e.g. Schmüdgen 1990)
opa-02-c3.claim: The Gelfand-Naimark-Segal (GNS) construction shows how a C*-algebra is represented on a Hilbert space.

opa-04-c1.text: nLab authors. von Neumann algebra. nLab.
opa-04-c1.quote: which is a topological condition, is by this result equivalent to an algebraic condition (being equal to its bicommutant).
opa-04-c1.claim: It says a von Neumann algebra is intrinsically defined by an algebraic condition (closure under double commutant) that turns out to coincide with topological closure.

opa-07-c2.text: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, Henry Yuen (2020). MIP*=RE. arXiv.
opa-07-c2.quote: Using a known connection, undecidability of the entangled value implies a negative answer to Tsirelson's problem
opa-07-c2.claim: By the established equivalences, MIP* = RE implies that Tsirelson's problem has a negative answer, and hence so does Connes embedding.

opa-03-c3.text: Elliott H. Lieb, Mary Beth Ruskai (1973). A fundamental property of quantum-mechanical entropy. Physical Review Letters 30(10), 434-436.
opa-03-c3.quote: We have proved the strong subadditivity of quantum-mechanical entropy and the Wigner-Yanase-Dyson conjecture.
opa-03-c3.claim: Strong subadditivity of S, proved by Lieb-Ruskai (1973), is an inequality of quantum information theory

opa-06-c1.text: Roland Speicher (2009). Free Probability Theory. arXiv.
opa-06-c1.quote: Free probability theory was created by Dan Voiculescu around 1985
opa-06-c1.claim: Dan Voiculescu introduced free probability in 1985 as a tool for attacking the free-group factor isomorphism problem
